Side-scrolling 2D game battle background, wide panorama, no characters. A flooded swamp waterway inside an underground world: the ground path across the bottom quarter is shallow murky water with mud banks, reeds and floating lily pads, half-sunken logs and stepping roots, dark teal water with ripples, twisted dead trees, low drifting mist. Three depth layers: far misty treeline, middle reeds and dead trees, and the flooded water path across the bottom quarter where the party wades. Same swamp, same colors and same art style as the reference image. 16-bit JRPG pixel art, crisp pixels, no people, no effects. Daytime under a hazy artificial sun, yellowish fog.
